about: Reviews on the omikuji rack. The words live in data/reviews/<id>.md and the cover in assets/reviews/<id>.webp. kind is "anime" or "manga". rating is out of 10 and becomes the fortune: 9+ 大吉, 8+ 中吉, 7+ 小吉, 6+ 吉, 4+ 末吉, below 4 凶. screenshots appear right below the review: each is a path (assets/reviews/<id>/01.webp, …) or { "src": path, "caption": text }. Both entries below are 見本 (samples) for the preview.
